known_instrument_limitations.oracle_bridge_arm: Derives the bridge by re-running extract_entities, so it fails identically to the deterministic arm wherever extraction fails. The OOD bridge/retrieval split is therefore unresolved. Fix: read latent bridge identity from generator metadata.

negative_results.adaptive_retrieval_trigger: 91 of 91 follow-ups positive, 0 negative; a fixed two-pass policy suffices and Gate D is expected to FAIL on this corpus
negative_results.calculate_action: 100 answers produced, +0.000 marginal quality; NOT promoted
negative_results.calculate_action_v3: -0.008 on v3 qualification; harmful, remains unqualified
negative_results.gate_d_v3: oracle trigger equals best fixed policy on both splits (opportunity +0.000); 50 positive / 450 neutral / 0 negative. No controller is justified.
negative_results.slot_label_echo: 99 -> 0 under precision packing; was an evidence-confusability artefact, not a prompt-interface or reasoning limit
negative_results.slot_label_echoes: Track evidence quality, not packet format: 85 -> 28 under precision packing, -> 3 under oracle evidence. F-arms would measure a symptom; implemented but unrun.

next_work: Information-gap / query-formulation layer independent of surface identifier shape: explicit known/target/missing-relation/candidate-bridge state, querying for the missing relation on the bridge rather than the bridge's name. Measured target: 0.394 -> 0.540 on qualification; the whole 0.080 -> 0.764 OOD span is unclaimed. Prerequisites: fix the oracle_bridge instrument, and replace entity anchoring with relation-aware connectivity.

gate_a0.claim: HRM-Text-1B can use correctly supplied external evidence on the controlled synthetic Gate A benchmark.

gate_b.claim: Lexical retrieval (BM25) dominates the tested dense representation on this identifier-heavy synthetic corpus, and recovers enough complete evidence sets to lift downstream answer quality far above the no-evidence baseline.
not_a_claim_about: dense retrieval being inferior in general
any dense stack other than MiniLM-L6-v2 single-vector mean-pooled cosine

gate_c0.claim: Bounded two-pass retrieval with entity-anchored precision packing reaches the oracle ceiling (1.000 quality, 1.000 complete-evidence-set recovery) with zero failures on the controlled synthetic corpus.
gate_c0.mechanistically: worked: reached the oracle ceiling with zero failures
not_a_claim_about: generalisation to unseen templates, source styles, or entity formats
any effect certified at family granularity
gate_c0.statistically: the pre-declared family-level promotion condition was not met; the rule was kept, the corpus is being replaced
gate_c0.why_not_promoted: Bridge structure exists in only 1 of 5 families, so a family-clustered bootstrap cannot certify a family-concentrated effect: LCB95 is +0.0000 for family, +0.0659 for template_id, +0.1080 for source_cluster_id.

gate_c1.claim: Bounded two-pass retrieval with entity-anchored packing does NOT generalize: it scores 0.394 on v3 qualification against a 0.828 oracle-evidence ceiling, and is entirely inert out of distribution (0.080 vs 0.764), where the entity extractor matches nothing.
not_a_claim_about: the reader, which scores 0.828 and 0.764 given perfect evidence
dense or semantic retrieval, which was not the mechanism under test
the OOD bridge/retrieval split, which the oracle_bridge instrument cannot currently resolve
gate_c1.root_cause: The mechanism performed lexical identifier chaining, not bridge inference. ENTITY_PATTERN requires a hyphen-digit suffix; it matches 0/250 OOD questions and 0/160 natural_name questions inside qualification, so zero follow-ups fire.
